text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaah...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Both Mejiro Palmer and Ines Fujin
lost steam.
Neither was able to seize victory in the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Aparapa, parapa~☆

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'm so totally woooobbly~.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Palmer-chan!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yeah, Ines...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Good job, even in defeat!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yeah! We showed some real guts!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: B-But still... am I being a bit too self-conscious?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah, true~. Being all stubborn,
pushing ourselves way too hard, wasn't it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking each other down, yet sharing a faint
spark of friendship... the Derby came to an end.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That night—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see☆
Ines's run today...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Assuming I do that,
then my bestie will run away too...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: What's up, Helios?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Nah, I just had a flash of inspiration
for a totally killer move, ya know?☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"It's a God-tier plan, but probs zero chance♪
More importantly, come on, let's get back to chilling out!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Shake up this soda pop☆, pop the cap, and inside—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Mantis Caller ★★★
Fooooooooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Waaagh, isn't that bad?!
Oh no... Gyaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the foam party celebrating a job well done
at the Derby went on late into the night.
